scope_note: Four supplementary public-web discovery checks. Public records/articles are distinct from API connectivity and from exact CBI-item matches. Search-indexed official metadata and direct HEAD outcomes are recorded separately.

platforms.title: Burma: Royal Engineers: Commander Royal Engineers Works: 177 CRE Works
platforms.note: Official Discovery metadata identifies a January–December 1945 war diary file at Kew. It explicitly says the record has not been digitised and cannot be downloaded. This is a related Burma record, not a verified CBI-site item match.
platforms.note_zh: Discovery 官方目录确认该卷为 1945 年 1–12 月的缅甸工兵相关档案，藏于邱园；明确说明尚未数字化、不可下载。它是缅甸主题的相关记录，并非与 CBI 网站某项内容相同的已核实记录。
platforms.access_note: Official search-indexed catalogue metadata read. Direct web-tool retrieval missed cache; a separate HEAD request returned HTTP 202. A 202 response does not prove the catalogue body was served.
platforms.access_note_zh: 已读到官方目录的搜索索引内容；网页工具直接获取遇到缓存缺失，另一次 HEAD 返回 HTTP 202。202 不代表已经返回有效目录正文。
platforms.next_step: Open the public catalogue manually, record the unit/date range, and use the repository copying or visit route if the full diary is needed. No API success is claimed.
platforms.next_step_zh: 在公开目录人工核对单位和日期；需要完整日记时按馆方复制或到馆流程办理。这里不表示 API 已成功接通。
platforms.rights_note: No media licence is inferred from public catalogue/article access. No media downloaded or embedded in this supplementary check.

platforms.note: Official JACAR metadata supplies reference code C12122376900, the holding institution and a Japanese telegram excerpt concerning air operations in Burma. A specific archival record is identified; none of its scanned pages or media has been fetched here.
platforms.note_zh: JACAR 官方元数据给出参考号 C12122376900、馆藏机构及涉及缅甸航空作战的日文电报摘要。已识别具体档案记录，本轮未抓取任何扫描页或媒体。
platforms.access_note: Official indexed record text was read; a direct HEAD returned HTTP 200 text/html. The image viewer and an API search response were not tested in this supplementary check.
platforms.access_note_zh: 已读到官方索引中的记录文本，直接 HEAD 返回 HTTP 200 text/html；本项补充检查未验证影像查看器或 API 搜索响应。
platforms.next_step: Open the record viewer manually, verify the relevant frame/date, preserve the NIDS shelfmark, and review the source reproduction terms before using scans.
platforms.next_step_zh: 人工打开记录查看器，核对相关画幅和日期，保留防卫研究所索书号，并在使用扫描件前确认来源条款。

platforms.title: 虎翔天際：Flying Tiger（官方文章 PDF，标题略写）
platforms.note: The official agency PDF contains a Flying Tigers research article and cites archival file numbers. It is an interpretive article pointing to records, not a catalogue item API response; the article and its embedded photographs have not been copied into the demo.
platforms.note_zh: 该机构官方 PDF 收录飞虎队主题研究文章，并引用若干档号。它是指向档案的介绍文章，不是单件档案 API 返回；未将文章或其中照片复制到演示。
platforms.access_note: Official search-indexed PDF text was read. Direct HEAD returned HTTP 200 application/pdf; the web tool timed out retrieving the full PDF. The title is deliberately abbreviated because indexed OCR differs on one character.
platforms.access_note_zh: 已读到官方 PDF 的搜索索引文本。直接 HEAD 返回 HTTP 200 application/pdf，网页工具获取完整 PDF 超时。因索引 OCR 的一个字不一致，这里采用略写标题。
platforms.next_step: Search the official National Archives Information website using the cited file numbers; verify item-level metadata, online image availability and reuse conditions separately.
platforms.next_step_zh: 用文中档号在国家档案资讯网检索，分别核实单件元数据、在线影像可用性与使用条件。

platforms.title: U.S. TROOPS ON ALASKAN FRONT [ETC.]
platforms.note: The official DPLA record describes a 1942 newsreel whose first part includes Flying Tigers preparing for a mission. It names NARA as partner and the National Archives at College Park – Motion Pictures as contributing institution. This is an aggregator record, not proof of a CBI-site match.
platforms.note_zh: DPLA 官方记录将其描述为 1942 年新闻片，第一部分包含飞虎队执行任务前的准备，并标明 NARA 为合作机构、College Park 电影档案部门为提供者。它是聚合目录记录，不证明与 CBI 页同片。
platforms.access_note: Official search-indexed item metadata was read. Direct web-tool access returned HTTP 403; HEAD returned HTTP 202. These responses do not establish a working public search API or playable film.
platforms.access_note_zh: 已读到官方条目的搜索索引元数据；网页工具直接访问返回 HTTP 403，HEAD 返回 HTTP 202。这些结果不能证明公共搜索 API 已接通或影片可播放。
platforms.next_step: Follow View Full Item to NARA in a browser, resolve the original NAID, and only then verify playback and rights. API credential setup remains a separate task.
platforms.next_step_zh: 在浏览器经 View Full Item 跟进 NARA 原馆，获取原始 NAID，再验证播放与使用条件。API 凭据配置仍是另一项工作。
